title: An etale algebra is finitely presented, and its principal localizations are etale
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then (1) $A\to B$ is of finite presentation: $B\cong A[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_m)$ as $A$-algebras for some $n,m\ge0$; in particular $B$ is a finitely generated $A$-algebra; (2) for every $s\in B$, the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}B_s\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ induced by $A\to B\to B_s=B[1/s]$ is etale.
